2026-10-22.content:
Support for organization-level audits, [audit
scheduling](https://docs.cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/run-audit), and a [new UI experience with
updated reports](https://docs.cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/view-audit) are generally available
([GA](https://cloud.google.com/products#product-launch-stages)).

summary.title: New Audit Features Now Available
summary.summary: Organization-level audits, audit scheduling, and an updated UI with new reports are now generally available. This release enhances your ability to manage and view audit information.

2026-09-25.content:
Audit Manager includes [Gemini-generated
summaries](https://docs.cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/view-audit#compliance-score) that provide
high-level information about the audit results for cloud controls, controls, or
resources in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products#product-launch-stages).

summary.title: New Gemini Summaries in Audit Manager
summary.summary: Audit Manager now offers Gemini-generated summaries for audit results. These summaries provide a high-level overview of compliance scores for cloud controls, controls, and resources, currently in Preview.

2026-09-18.content:
You can [download FedRAMP 20x Class B (Low) compliance
documents](https://docs.cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/download_compliance_documents) from Audit
Manager.

summary.title: Compliance Documents Available
summary.summary: You can now download FedRAMP 20x Class B (Low) compliance documents directly from Audit Manager. This feature allows for easier access to essential compliance information.

2026-09-04.content:
The [remote Model Context Protocol (MCP)
server](https://docs.cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/use-audit-manager-mcp) for Audit Manager is
generally available
([GA](https://cloud.google.com/products#product-launch-stages)).

summary.title: Remote Model Context Protocol Server is now available
summary.summary: The remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Audit Manager has reached general availability. This feature allows for enhanced management of audit processes.

2026-07-17.content:
Audit Manager includes the following features in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products#product-launch-stages):

* A new [UI and report experience](https://docs.cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/view-audit#compliance-score)
* Ability to [schedule audits](https://docs.cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/run-audit)
* Ability to run audits at an organization level

summary.title: Audit Manager Enhancements Now in Preview
summary.summary: Audit Manager is introducing new features in preview, including an updated UI and reporting experience, the ability to schedule audits, and the option to run audits at the organization level. These enhancements aim to streamline compliance management and reporting processes.

2026-07-02.content:
Audit Manager now supports [built-in frameworks and custom
frameworks](https://docs.cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/overview#supported_compliance) that you define
using Compliance Manager or Assured Workloads frameworks (preview).

summary.title: Audit Manager: New Framework Support
summary.summary: Audit Manager now supports built-in and custom frameworks. You can define your own compliance frameworks using Compliance Manager or Assured Workloads frameworks (preview) to enhance your auditing process.

2025-08-27.content: Audit Manager lets you [download Google Cloud compliance documents](https://cloud.google.com/audit-manager/docs/download_compliance_documents). You can use these documents to better understand how Google addresses its responsibilities to meet the requirements of various regulatory frameworks.

summary.title: Compliance Documents Available
summary.summary: Users can now download compliance documents from Audit Manager to understand Google Cloud
